metadata.notes: OBSERVED 2026-09-20: native bare-UUID child linked by durable parentSession; child ready then parent ready 33 ms later; verifier passed 7/7 phases.

assessment.body:
## Verdict

agent_supports: yes
daemon_capability: full
driver_capability: ready

## Observed run

The live recording `2026-09-20-22-27-52_irrlichd-0.6.4+1d14139` observed parent `session-86f1a16a-dd93-435d-bf20-758291b25328` and native child `9ebaa8d8-38cb-46b3-9529-d495ed46c11f`. The child header has `origin: subagent` and `parentSession` equal to the parent id. The child became ready at `22:31:04.912494`. The parent became ready at `22:31:04.945876`, 33 ms later. `of verify --agent deepseek-harness --scenario background-subagent --json` passed all seven lifecycle phases and all transcript, event, and observation assertions.

## Transcript behavior

The parent received one initial user prompt. It made one background `subagent` call and received one started result. Parent turn 1 completed with `LAUNCHED` before the child completed. DSH then wrote one `agent-message` relay and one `subagent-settled` notice. Those daemon notices caused completed parent turns 2 and 3. The driver sent no extra prompt. The contract requires these three completed parent turns, one relay, one settled notice, one child call and result, and no approval.

## Current daemon behavior

The current DSH adapter accepts the validated bare-UUID native child directory. It reads the durable `parentSession` header and emits the child lifecycle and parent link. The child link holds the parent while the child is active and releases the parent after the child is ready. The earlier bare-UUID rejection diagnosis describes the pre-fix adapter only.
caveats: The verified recording used irrlichd 0.6.4+1d14139 and DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.2 with the local qwen/qwen3.5-9b route.

DSH can write atomic transcript replacements. The lifecycle contract binds the observed held-working span and the final child-to-parent drain order, not a claim that no transient file event can occur.
The native child shares the parent DSH process. The proof requires a distinct child session and durable ParentSessionID link, not a distinct PID.
The exact 3.2 contract is recording-specific: DSH emits the agent-message relay and subagent-settled notice, which create the second and third completed parent turns.

sources.note: Official installed package reference: continuable background calls return a durable child id immediately and do not wait for a result.
The shipped standard preset mounts the spawn-backed subagent tool with backgroundMode continuable.
The tool schema exposes run_in_background, defaults it to true for continuable mode, and routes true to startContinuable.
The official installed implementation creates a separate child with a bare randomUUID and passes childSessionMeta into Agent creation.
childSessionMeta writes parentSession and origin subagent into the durable child header.
Official persistence contract: each session gets its own directory and physical header under the configured sessions root.
Installed TUI source states that a child id is bare and its persisted directory uses the same bare id.
Current adapter accepts ordinary session-UUID directories and validated bare-UUID native child directories.
Current DSH source wires both SessionIDFromPath and ParentSessionIDFromPath.
Current adapter reads the compressed child header to validate origin subagent and durable parentSession before linking.
ParentSessionIDFromPath is the existing daemon seam for transcript stores whose parent relationship lives in a metadata header.
hasActiveChildren and parent reevaluation hold a linked parent in working until the active child drains.
ComputeSubagentSummary includes file-backed children whose ParentSessionID matches the parent.
The driver implements send, wait_turn, and sleep and pins the local LM Studio model through per-run settings.

preconditions: dsh 0.1.5-rc.2 or newer is on PATH and the active TUI profile uses the standard preset
the active preset exposes the in-process continuable subagent tool and accepts run_in_background:true; re-probe the live tool surface at record time
LM Studio is serving qwen/qwen3.5-9b through http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1; re-probe the live model roster at record time
irrlichd is recording with DeepSeek Harness transcript permission granted
setup: Create a fresh per-run cwd and launch the DSH TUI through the interactive driver
Apply the temporary LM Studio and qwen model patch without modifying the installed TUI profile
Resolve the post-marker parent session.v3.jsonl.zstd before sending input

script.text: Use the subagent tool exactly once. Set description to delayed marker. Set prompt to: Use the bash tool to run exactly `sleep 50 && printf CHILD_DONE`. After it succeeds, reply with exactly CHILD_DONE and no other text. Set run_in_background to true. Do not call send_message, list_agents, or any result-reading tool. Do not wait for the child. As soon as the subagent tool returns its durable child id, reply with exactly LAUNCHED and no other text.

verify: the raw parent transcript contains exactly one subagent tool call whose arguments explicitly set run_in_background to true
the subagent call has a matching successful result containing started subagent and a durable child id
the parent's completed turn/end follows the start result and precedes the child's completed turn/end, which distinguishes this background run from a foreground clone
the raw child transcript header carries origin subagent and parentSession equal to the parent session id
events.jsonl shows a distinct child transcript_new event and parent_linked for that child
the parent stays working for at least 30 seconds after the child link, with no ready or waiting transition while the child is active
the child reaches ready and only then the parent reaches ready
the recording reports model qwen/qwen3.5-9b and non-zero tokens
recipe.scope_note: await_child_turn_end scans only transcript files newer than this run's marker. It discovers a bare-UUID child only when its durable header has origin subagent and parentSession equal to the active parent. It polls that child transcript until a completed turn/end or the scenario deadline. It fails loudly for an absent child, unreadable child transcript, wrong current-run parent, or missing completed turn/end. await_parent_ready then polls the recording daemon's /api/v1/sessions snapshot for the same parent session until it is ready. It fails loudly for an unreadable or malformed snapshot, an absent parent session, or a parent that remains non-ready.
